Generate the autocompletion script for yeet for the specified shell.
See each sub-command's help for details on how to use the generated script.

Usage:
  yeet completion [command]

Examples:
  yeet completion zsh
  yeet completion bash > /usr/local/etc/bash_completion.d/yeet

Available Commands:
  bash        Generate the autocompletion script for bash
  fish        Generate the autocompletion script for fish
  powershell  Generate the autocompletion script for powershell
  zsh         Generate the autocompletion script for zsh

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for completion

Global Flags:
      --no-color   disable colored output
      --quiet      show warnings and errors only
  -v, --verbose    enable debug logging

Use "yeet completion [command] --help" for more information about a command.
